extractions.value: Patient had grip myotonia-like movements and postural tremor in both hands. Grip strength was 9 kg in both hands. Pain scores: NRS 80/100, widespread pain 12/19, severity score 5/12. Barthel Index 85/100. Ultrasonography was used to quantify muscle contractions, with total counts decreasing from 90 to 36 after treatment. Muscle contractions were mainly in appendicular muscles and less frequently in axial muscles. 8–10 Hz grouped discharges on needle EMG suggested central generation of involuntary contractions.
